views.description: Unique public view names; omitted or null selects agentview. Physical RGB views retain their returned native size; pointcloud_top/front/side are derived views.

history_point_ids.description: Previously solved point identifiers to overlay; omitted or null adds no history marks. Identifiers are local measurement references, not object identities.

point_id.description: Nonempty local identifier for this physical point; reuse across complementary views of the same point, never across different points.

view.description: The exact view name whose returned pixel is being measured; actual camera or derived view, not a camera chosen from an old observation.

x.description: Horizontal integer pixel at the returned view size, OpenCV top-left origin; dynamic image bounds apply.

y.description: Vertical integer pixel at the returned view size, OpenCV top-left origin; dynamic image bounds apply.

target_xyz_world_m.description: Absolute grip-site [x,y,z] in world metres; omit to hold measured current position. Mutually exclusive with translation_delta_mm.

translation_delta_mm.description: Grip-site translation [x,y,z] in millimetres in translation_delta_frame; omit to hold position. Mutually exclusive with target_xyz_world_m.

translation_delta_frame.description: Frame for translation_delta_mm: fixed world axes or measured action-start grip_site axes; omitted defaults to world.

target_orientation_world_xyzw.description: Absolute world grip-site quaternion [x,y,z,w]; omit to preserve current orientation. Mutually exclusive with axis-direction orientation fields.

grip_site_z_axis_world.description: World direction [x,y,z] for local grip-site +Z; normalized by the shared pose compiler. Alternative to a quaternion; an omitted second axis preserves the closest compatible orientation.

grip_site_x_axis_world.description: World direction [x,y,z] for local grip-site +X; normalized by the shared pose compiler. If +Z is supplied the two directions must be approximately orthogonal.

target_xyz_world_m.description: Absolute grip-site [x,y,z] in world metres; omit to hold measured current position. Mutually exclusive with translation_delta_mm.

translation_delta_mm.description: Grip-site translation [x,y,z] in millimetres in translation_delta_frame; omit to hold position. Mutually exclusive with target_xyz_world_m.

translation_delta_frame.description: Frame for translation_delta_mm: fixed world axes or measured action-start grip_site axes; omitted defaults to world.

target_orientation_world_xyzw.description: Absolute world grip-site quaternion [x,y,z,w]; omit to preserve current orientation. Mutually exclusive with axis-direction orientation fields.

grip_site_z_axis_world.description: World direction [x,y,z] for local grip-site +Z; normalized by the shared pose compiler. Alternative to a quaternion; an omitted second axis preserves the closest compatible orientation.

grip_site_x_axis_world.description: World direction [x,y,z] for local grip-site +X; normalized by the shared pose compiler. If +Z is supplied the two directions must be approximately orthogonal.

preview_id.description: Current observation-bound preview reference; supply this field alone instead of direct pose fields. Stale references are refused.

message.description: Nonempty issue description from current public evidence; does not request human steering or change the task.

outcome.description: Policy lifecycle outcome: success requires a prior true checker result; failure requires reason and exhausted attempts; abort does not declare task success.

reason.description: Outcome rationale; omitted defaults to empty, but failure requires nonempty text.

attempts.description: Nonempty descriptions of exhausted attempts for failure; optional or null for other outcomes. Does not count as action evidence.
